设计意图： Combine normalized drawdown (primary parent strength) with volatility persistence ratio (ATR40/ATR10) from secondary parent. The persistence ratio modulates the drawdown signal: when longer-term volatility is elevated relative to short-term volatility, the drawdown is given higher weight, capturing environments where volatility clustering may amplify mean-reversion. -(drawdown = close/ts_max(60, close)-1; vol = ts_std(20, returns); normalized_drawdown = drawdown/vol; persistence = ts_atr(40)/ts_atr(10); factor = normalized_drawdown * clip(persistence,0.5,2.0))
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📚 字段与算子释义

输入字段

字段含义说明
open开盘价基础行情字段
high最高价基础行情字段
low最低价基础行情字段
close收盘价基础行情字段
volume成交量基础行情字段
factor因子输出因子输出
normalized_drawdown归一化回撤回撤 / ATR 等风险尺度归一化

算子

算子含义
ts_maxts_max(x, n) → 滚动最大值
ts_stdts_std(x, n) → 滚动标准差
ts_atrts_atr(n) → 平均真实波幅 (ATR, high/low/close 输入)
clipclip(x, lo, hi) → 裁剪到区间

  168. 步骤168：ts_mean(v167(true_range)) → 窗口 10 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  169. 步骤169：where(v161(eq), v163(log), v168(ts_mean)) → 条件选择
  170. 步骤170：divide(v155(ts_mean), v169(where)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  171. 步骤171：clip(v170(divide), 0.5, 2.0) → 裁剪到 [lo, hi] 区间
  172. 步骤172：multiply(v150(divide), v171(clip)) → 乘法：x × y
  173. 步骤173：where(v132(eq), v134(log), v172(multiply)) → 条件选择
  174. 步骤174：where(v88(eq), v90(log), v173(where)) → 条件选择
  175. 步骤175：fillna(v174(where), 0) → 用指定值填充 NaN

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 rolling_max：close.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).max()
  2. 计算 drawdown：close / rolling_max - 1.0
  3. 计算 vol：returns.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).std()
  4. 计算 normalized_drawdown：drawdown / vol
  5. 计算 high：high.values.astype(float64)
  6. 计算 low：low.values.astype(float64)
  7. 计算 close：close.values.astype(float64)
  8. 计算 atr40：talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=40)
  9. 计算 atr10：talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=10)
  10. 计算 atr40：pd.Series(atr40, index=df_copy.index)
  11. 计算 atr10：pd.Series(atr10, index=df_copy.index)
  12. 计算 persistence：atr40 / atr10
  13. 计算 persistence：persistence.clip(lower=0.5, upper=2.0)
  14. 计算 factor：normalized_drawdown * persistence
  15. 计算 factor：factor
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

📊 输入字段释义 (dataaccess 标准列)

列名含义说明
open开盘价基础行情字段
high最高价基础行情字段
low最低价基础行情字段
close收盘价基础行情字段
volume成交量基础行情字段

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. ATR(40) — talib.ATR(high, low, close, n) → 平均真实波幅
  2. ATR(10) — talib.ATR(high, low, close, n) → 平均真实波幅
  3. clip(persistence,0.5,2.0) — clip(x, lo, hi) → 裁剪到区间

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_vol_persistence(df): df_copy = df.copy() rolling_max = df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(60, min_periods=60).max() drawdown = df_copy["str">'close'] / rolling_max - 1.0 returns = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() vol = returns.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std().replace(0, np.nan) normalized_drawdown = drawdown / vol high = df_copy["str">'high'].values.astype("str">'float64') low = df_copy["str">'low'].values.astype("str">'float64') close = df_copy["str">'close'].values.astype("str">'float64') atr40 = talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=40) atr10 = talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=10) atr40 = pd.Series(atr40, index=df_copy.index) atr10 = pd.Series(atr10, index=df_copy.index) persistence = atr40 / atr10.replace(0, np.nan) persistence = persistence.clip(lower=0.5, upper=2.0) factor = normalized_drawdown * persistence factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) factor.name = "factor_drawdown_vol_persistence" "kw">class="kw">return factor
